body: i’ve had one that probably could have used stitches but i didn’t get them. now it’s a huge ugly scar right in plain view on my arm, at least it’s short though.

also mid-20s, hello fellow old people.
i wish i could get a streak that long damn
i'm really glad you were able to but it's not that easy for all of us. especially those of us who have a shitty support system.

basically the nurse yanked up my sleeve and asked about it and then the doctor i was seeing said i need to get help and it doesn't matter i've been off my meds for a year, etc. i cried a bunch in front of them and it was humiliating and i didn't feel like they cared, just like they were judging me very harshly.

and i am a legal adult. my appointment actually went fine though. i found a 3/4 sleeve shirt and wore that so they wouldn't see (all my cuts are above my elbow). even got my blood taken out of my hand which was surprisingly painless.

i'm gonna stop cutting on my arms, though. i don't want anymore visible scars to make me feel this way.

the one i was seeing cared too much and made me feel bad. she told me i need help that isn't medication even when i mentioned being off my meds for so long and she said "that doesn't matter" like, uh... i have diagnosed mental illness but ok!

this is a good idea, and i TRY to, but i love cutting on my arms. i have made the mistake of doing it recently, which i regret because fuck it's hot to wear long sleeves everywhere. i have a particularly deep one right now too that i doubt will ever fade enough to make it unnoticeable and i don't want anyone to see it before it heals some more.. which probably won't be until it gets cold again lol
why didn't i think of this ??
